name: the first send skips the sheet
why: quickSend sends before the player has agreed on the sheet

name: the callsign rides along on a one-tap send
why: quickSend takes the callsign though the player ticked nothing

name: the sheet ignores the tick
why: body takes the callsign whatever the box says

name: a refused send says nothing
why: a refused upload goes back to the sheet or the results card without telling the player

name: a stalled upload
why: send has no TIMEOUT_MS abort, so an upload the server never answers leaves the player on Sending
